exp_0_baseline.name: EXP-0 (Baseline Control)
exp_0_baseline.description: Pure baseline control using standard YOLO11n uniform sampling and augmentations.

exp_1_adaptive_sampling.name: EXP-1 (Mixture Adaptive Sampling)
exp_1_adaptive_sampling.description: Ablation variant enabling mixture adaptive sampling based on OOF difficulty manifest.

exp_2_targeted_aug.name: EXP-2 (Targeted Context Augmentation)
exp_2_targeted_aug.description: Ablation variant enabling on-the-fly targeted context crop for hard small lesions.

exp_3_full_proposed.name: EXP-3 (Full Proposed Method)
exp_3_full_proposed.description: Full proposed method combining mixture adaptive sampling and targeted context augmentation.

runtime_defaults_rationale.epochs_30: Reduced from legacy 50 epochs to balance convergence with training runtime on RTX 4060.
runtime_defaults_rationale.patience_10: Early stopping stops unpromising runs after 10 epochs without validation improvement.
runtime_defaults_rationale.workers_2: Optimized for Windows dataloading without shared-memory exhaustion or CPU thrashing.
runtime_defaults_rationale.amp_true: Enables FP16 mixed precision on Tensor Cores for ~2x throughput and 50% memory reduction.
runtime_defaults_rationale.plots_false: Disables redundant matplotlib figure generation during training to save disk I/O and time.
runtime_defaults_rationale.close_mosaic_6: Disables mosaic in the last 6 epochs (20% of 30) for fine-grained feature stabilization.
